title: Farm Project Appraisal
modules: Will Elaborate More On Agribusiness Project Plan And Agribusiness Project
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a systematic and objective assessment of an ongoing or completed project (International Labour Organisation -ILO- , 2018)."
Project evaluation is a systematic and objective assessment of an ongoing or completed project (International Labour Organisation -ILO- , 2018).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to convert future value into their present value."
The discount rate is used to convert future value into their present value.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a process that critically examines a project."
Evaluation is a process that critically examines a project.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an important decision making tool that lays the foundations for better delivery and justification for spending money on a project."
Agribusiness project appraisal is an important decision making tool that lays the foundations for better delivery and justification for spending money on a project.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as the interest rate that equates the present value or the expected future cash flow, or receipts, to the initial cost outlay."
IRR is defined as the interest rate that equates the present value or the expected future cash flow, or receipts, to the initial cost outlay.
fib: ______ is the rate of return that comes to agribusiness beyond the project's cost of capital.
Note that the IRR is the rate of return that comes to agribusiness beyond the project's cost of capital.
______ is a specific activity with a starting point and a specific ending point intended to accomplish specific objectives.
Project is a specific activity with a starting point and a specific ending point intended to accomplish specific objectives.
______ is a means of choosing appropriate (or determining the best alternative) technology of production especially concerning whether to adopt labour or capital intensive technology.
Discounting rate is a means of choosing appropriate (or determining the best alternative) technology of production especially concerning whether to adopt labour or capital intensive technology.
______ is a critical step in your agribusiness assessment process.
The feasibility study is a critical step in your agribusiness assessment process.
